title: Zustand
description: Build a small global store with Zustand v5, select the slices you need, and persist it safely.

data.text: Zustand is a tiny state library built on `useSyncExternalStore`. A store is just a hook; there is no provider required, which makes it an easy replacement for context-heavy state.

data.caption: src/stores/cartStore.ts

data.text: The `create<CartState>()(...)` form is the TypeScript-friendly signature in Zustand v4/v5. `set` merges the returned object into state; `get` reads the current state inside actions.

data.caption: Selecting state without over-rendering

data.title: Selecting the whole store re-renders on every change
data.text: `useCartStore()` with no selector subscribes to everything. Always select the smallest slice, and reach for `useShallow` when the selector returns a new object or array.

data.caption: Persisting part of the store

data.title: Install and reset between tests

terms.definition: A hook created by create() that holds state and actions.
A function passed to the store hook that extracts one value and determines re-renders.
Equality helper that prevents a new object from triggering a render on every store change.
Serialises selected state to storage and rehydrates it on load.

items.question: Zustand or Redux?
items.answer: Zustand for small-to-medium apps and quick adoption with minimal ceremony; Redux Toolkit when you want a strict, inspectable action log, DevTools time travel, or a large team standard.

items.question: Does Zustand cause stale reads in actions?
items.answer: No. Use the get() helper inside an action to read fresh state instead of closing over the render-time value.

data.title: What interviewers look for
data.text: Explain that Zustand avoids context re-renders because components subscribe to individual selectors, and that it has no provider and no action types.

data.title: Key takeaways
points: create<T>()(...) defines state and actions in one hook.
Select the smallest slice; use useShallow for derived objects.
persist middleware serialises a subset of state.
No provider makes Zustand easy to adopt incrementally.
data.takeaway: Zustand is the usual answer to "do I really need Redux?" — know its selector-based performance story.
